title: Mochizuki Honami — Looking For My Answer〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Honami's Room

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Start slow and gradually go faster...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Decelerate slowly once you get to the fastest part and...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Phew...
I'm starting to feel it in my arms.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Now, I just need to play along to our demo recording and...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes. First, I'd like to start by asking you all a question. What aspirations do you hold for your music...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What aspirations do you hold for your music...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I was hoping that practicing would help take my mind off that question, but I keep going back to it...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Still, I do need to find an answer.
What am I hoping to achieve with our music?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I understand very well what Ichika and Saki want to do.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I do agree with them in terms of hoping to cheer others up and bring people together through our music.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But can I truly say those are my own feelings...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(What is most important to me...?
What do I hope to accomplish through music...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Where do I even start...?)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Honami.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Huh...?
Wait, MEIKO...?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What brings you here?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I was wondering how you were doing is all.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <You said you'd be taking time to think by yourself, remember? I wanted to know how you were doing.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, I see...
Thank you for showing so much concern.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Sorry for the sudden intrusion.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
I was just practicing on my own.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Okay, that's good to hear. Still...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <From what I saw just now, you seemed to be having trouble focusing on what you were doing...>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Was it that obvious?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Is that question really nagging at you?>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes... I've been giving it some thought, but I'm really struggling to find an answer...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I decided to do some practicing on my own in the hopes that taking a hard look at my instrument would lead me to a clue.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Unfortunately, I didn't get anywhere since my mind kept jumping between thinking and practicing.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I see...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I understand how you feel, since being told to relax or not be so anxious usually ends up having the opposite effect.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, true...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Then, why not try looking at it this way?>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <It's something very important, so try thinking about it at your own pace.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <You always think about what's best for those around you. But there's also what's best for you. A pace that suits you, Honami...>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: A pace that suits me...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Yes, your path of least resistance. The one that doesn't make you stress.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <It's like the drums. You can't achieve a good sound by hitting the living daylights out of them, right?>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I know you want to find the right answer as soon as possible. But first, you need to take some deep breaths!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <And wait for inspiration to strike!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <How does that sound? Wouldn't it be easier to take it slow?>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, you may be right...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'll take a nice, long bath, relax for a bit and come back to it when I feel ready...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Yes, I think that would be best.
Warm yourself up with a long, relaxing soak.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, thank you!
I'll go do that now.
